disclaimer: Development factor set. Replace with documented national or regional factors before any public reporting.

units.diet: kg CO2e per person per month
units.waste: kg CO2e per household per month
units.flight: kg CO2e per economy flight (assumed 1200 km)

assumptions: Development values only; not suitable for regulatory or verified carbon reporting.
Shared modes are attributed per passenger; occupancy is applied before comparison.
Cooking estimates are monthly per household, except LPG which scales with cylinders.
Diet and waste factors are broad placeholders while a documented national dataset is selected.
Avoided emissions compare a baseline journey with the alternative over the same distance and time period.

Opportunity estimates in the app use planning assumptions (e.g. 5% electricity reduction, 10% standby/cooling cut, 20% LPG stretch, 30% dietary shift factor) for guidance only; replace with documented factors before public reporting.
